description: Reference backtest: BTCUSDT 1h 2024-04-01 to 2024-05-30, default strategy_config.json -- same scenario as reference_run.json, with an added bar_equity expectation block for fix/metrics-bar-equity. Kept as its own fixture (not merged into reference_run.json) so this feature's regression test doesn't couple to core's fixture lifecycle, matching warmup_prefetch_reference.json's precedent.
e010_s3_rebaseline_2026-09-10: DECLARED DEFAULT-BEHAVIOR CHANGE (CLAUDE.fork.md rule #4), not a regression -- see tests/fixtures/reference_run.json's own e010_s3_rebaseline_2026-09-10 note for the full explanation. Real per-symbol slippage (BTCUSDT=1bps) became the default fill-price adjustment; max_drawdown_pct/sharpe/sortino/turnover move accordingly (worse, as expected -- slippage is a cost). exposure_pct, n_bars_total, n_bars_warmup_excluded, n_daily_returns, and n_downside_days are UNCHANGED -- slippage moves fill price, not bar counts or position timing. Measured by re-running this exact fixture's backtest (bar_equity=True) against the post-S3 code on 2026-09-10.
note: Measured 2026-07-31 on run 20260731T000021Z_5ccbec42 (config_sha256 5ccbec42, data_sha256 5a75366c) and cross-checked by an independent from-scratch pandas computation over portfolio_states.csv outside performance/bar_equity.py, at the regime != 'NOT_READY' boundary (119 rows). n_bars_total is portfolio_states.csv's row count for this window; n_bars_warmup_excluded is the count of leading NOT_READY rows. Sortino re-measured 2026-07-31 (fix round) under the textbook target-0 downside-deviation convention (sqrt(mean(min(r,0)^2)) over ALL daily returns) -- was -2.9385 under the earlier sample-std-of-negative-days convention; max_drawdown_pct, sharpe, exposure_pct, turnover, n_bars_total, and n_bars_warmup_excluded are unchanged by that switch, confirmed by rerun.
e012_rebaseline_2026-08-09: fix/e012-last-two-bars corrected the replay-gate off-by-one and the missing end-of-backtest candle flush (data/data_manager.py), which were silently dropping the last 2 fetched bars of every backtest. Re-measured on the same config_sha256 (5ccbec42) and data_sha256 (5a75366c) -- both unchanged, and trades.json is byte-identical (sha256[:12] f73cb9921725 both before and after) because the 2 recovered bars (2024-05-30 22:00, 23:00) are flat/unknown-regime and emit no trade on this window. Only n_bars_total (1438->1440, the 2 recovered bars) and exposure_pct (3.7908->3.785, diluted by 2 more mostly-flat bars) moved; max_drawdown_pct, sharpe, sortino, turnover, n_bars_warmup_excluded, n_daily_returns, and n_downside_days are unchanged. Control run against the pre-fix commit (79bf2796) reproduced every pre-rebaseline value in this fixture byte-for-byte before this update was made -- see PHASE_BC_RESULTS.md.
